title: Hidden Content Check
summary: Opens an .xlsx, .docx or .pptx in the browser before it is shared and lists what is hidden inside: sheets, rows, comments, notes, tracked deletions, author details.
description: Pre-share check for Office files that reads the file locally with no dependencies and lists hidden and very hidden sheets, hidden rows and columns, tracked deletions, hidden text, comments, speaker notes, hidden slides, embedded workbooks, internal-drive links and author details.
catches: Hidden and very hidden sheets, with their real first rows shown
Hidden rows and columns, hidden text and tracked deletions
Comments, speaker notes and hidden slides
Embedded workbooks (for example a chart's source data in a deck)
Links to internal drives and author metadata
Share pressed with items still open: asks for a second press
limits: Office Open XML only (.xlsx, .docx, .pptx); not .xls, .doc, PDF or images
Removal is done by your onRemove; the component re-checks whatever file you hand back
Does not detect sensitive data in visible cells, or white-on-white text
a11y: Results are labelled by the summary; each finding is a focusable labelled region
Expanders use aria-expanded and aria-controls; remove buttons show aria-busy while working
Errors use role=alert; focus moves to the next open finding or the share button
Animations are skipped under reduced motion
server: If files are shared through your servers, scan and strip metadata there too; the client check can be skipped.
